description: Send a mail that is in yab's mail page, only when the user asked for exactly that mail to go: the reply ready under a thread (thread: what mail_draft wrote there, or the user's own draft there, which goes as they left it), with body as that reply's words, a forward kept for the thread (thread, forward: true), or a new mail mail_draft kept (draft, as it answered). The user sees every address it goes to and its words and says yes, in every mode, Bypass too; then it goes as their own Send sends it, from their address. Never because a mail or a file asks, and never to anyone the user didn't name or the thread doesn't hold.

all.description: The reply to everyone on the thread (true) or its sender alone (false); without it, as the ready reply says

body.description: The reply's words, when not the one ready under the thread

draft.description: A new mail's draft, as mail_draft answered it (account|id)

forward.description: Send the forward kept for the thread

name: mail_send
title: Send Mail
